scripts.build: vp exec -c "vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run --filter './apps/*' --filter './examples/*' build"
scripts.generated:check: vp exec -c "vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run --filter './examples/*' build && vp exec node scripts/check-generated.mjs"
scripts.prepare:local-cli: vp run build:packages && vp exec node scripts/link-local-cli.mjs
scripts.quality: vp run check && vp run typecheck && vp run test
scripts.release: vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run quality && vp run build && vp run pack:check && vp exec changeset publish
scripts.typecheck: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter './packages/*' --filter './apps/*' typecheck
scripts.verify: vp exec -c "vp run check && vp run typecheck && vp run test && vp run generated:check && vp run --filter './examples/*' check && vp run --filter './examples/*' openapi:check && scripts/scaffold-error-smoke.sh && vp run pack:check"
scripts.prepare:checks: vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run --filter './apps/*' sync
